answer: Admitted agents hold one quill: an identity-bound hardware signing key that cannot be copied, so extra puppets each need fresh leases. Leases are granted on the review terrace, a fixed-capacity bench vetting applicants per epoch, quota bounded; none hold two. Signed messages emit a pulse keyed to the lease's slot seed, clones break cadence instantly. An attacker needing N identities pays N admission duties, runs N pulse schedules, re-earns leases every epoch: no bulk discount, cost grows with N. An honest agent clears the terrace once.
